about: Schools that can receive opt-in "Have [School] contact me" requests. Empty by default, so no student sees the button. The button also needs SCHOOL_INQUIRIES_ENABLED=1. List a school by its exact name as it appears on DegreeSteps plans (for example "Western Governors University"). Being on this list never changes which plans, schools or courses are shown, or their order: planning, ranking, the finder, the credits page and the plan index never read this file. Requests are stored in D1 for the owner to export and forward by hand; nothing is sent to a school automatically.
